rationale: Identity verification and order lookup were handled correctly, and the agent obtained explicit confirmation before making changes and honored the user's request to use PayPal. However, multiple policy-aligned requirements were not met: (1) The user requested that all other specifications remain the same except zoom. The agent proposed and executed an exchange to a 30MP model, changing the resolution from the original 24MP, violating the user's constraint. (2) The agent listed and selected a 30MP 10x SD variant and price ($3,066.23) not supported by the product details tool; the tool only showed a 30MP 10x CF variant marked unavailable. This constitutes stating unsupported/fabricated product details. (3) The agent performed the exchange using a new_item_id ("9228757377") that was never retrieved or verified via read-only tools, violating the policy requirement to inspect products before writes and not invent missing facts. (4) The agent did not ensure "maximum zoom capacity" across available options or confirm availability. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
